The softmax function turns raw scores in.zh: softmax 函数将原始分数转化为概率。温度旋钮 $T$ 控制该分布的尖锐或平坦程度 —— 它与驱动大语言模型创造力以及蒸馏中知识传递的是同一个旋钮。本页通过实时公式、实时采样与实时熵，帮你建立起直觉。
The softmax function turns raw scores in.src:
The softmax function turns raw scores into probabilities. The temperature
      knob $T$ controls how peaky or flat that distribution is—and is the
      same dial that powers creativity in LLMs and knowledge in distillation.
      This page lets you build the intuition with live formulas, live samples,
      and live entropy.

@@T0@@~12 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Le.zh:
@@T0@@约 12 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 损失函数 · 采样@@T3@@

Your network's last layer outputs @@T0@@.zh: 你网络的最后一层输出 @@T0@@logit@@T1@@：$K$ 个类别上的原始实值分数 $z_1, z_2, \ldots, z_K$。它们可以为负，可以大于 1，可以是任何值。但要进行分类或从模型中采样，你需要一个 @@T2@@概率分布@@T3@@：即和为 1 的、位于 $[0,1]$ 中的数。
Your network's last layer outputs @@T0@@.src: Your network's last layer outputs logits: raw real-valued scores $z_1, z_2, \ldots, z_K$ for $K$ classes. They can be negative, larger than one, anything. But to do classification or sample from the model, you need a probability distribution: numbers in $[0,1]$ that sum to one.

You could just normalize: $p_k = z_k / \.zh: 你大可直接归一化：$p_k = z_k / \sum_j z_j$。但只要有任何一个 $z_k$ 为负，这就会失败。你也可以先平移再归一化。但为何偏偏选那个平移量？softmax 才是更有原理依据的答案：它自然地由最大似然框架导出，并且具有一个漂亮的梯度。
You could just normalize: $p_k = z_k / \.src:
You could just normalize: $p_k = z_k / \sum_j z_j$. But that fails if any
      $z_k$ is negative. You could shift then normalize. But why pick that
      particular shift? Softmax is the principled answer: it arises naturally
      from the maximum likelihood framework, and it has a beautiful gradient.

Exponentiating guarantees positivity. Di.zh: 取指数保证了正值。除以总和保证了它们加起来为 1。我们将在第 2 步遇到的「温度」版本，在取指数之前对 logit 进行缩放 —— 随之而来的是现代深度学习中最有用的旋钮之一。
Exponentiating guarantees positivity. Di.src:
Exponentiating guarantees positivity. Dividing by the sum guarantees they
      add to one. The "temperature" version, which we'll meet in Step 2, scales
      the logits before exponentiating—and with it comes one of the most
      useful knobs in modern deep learning.

Edit the five logit values below. The ba.zh: 编辑下面这五个 logit 值。右侧的柱状图显示在温度 $T = 1$ 下由此得到的 softmax 概率。注意 @@T0@@相对次序@@T1@@ 如何被保留：最大的 logit 成为最大的概率。还要注意取指数如何放大了差异 —— 一个为 2 的 logit 差距会变成 $e^2 \approx 7.4$ 的概率比。
Edit the five logit values below. The ba.src: Edit the five logit values below. The bar chart on the right shows the resulting softmax probabilities at temperature $T = 1$. Notice how the relative order is preserved: the largest logit becomes the largest probability. Notice also how exponentiation amplifies differences—a logit gap of 2 becomes a probability ratio of $e^2 \approx 7.4$.

LLM next-token · \"the sky is...\".zh: LLM 下一词元 ·「the sky is...」

Image · ambiguous (cat / fox / dog).zh: 图像 · 歧义（猫 / 狐狸 / 狗）

Image · confident (one class).zh: 图像 · 自信（一个类别）

Bars show softmax probabilities $p_k$ at.zh: 柱形显示在 $T = 1$ 下的 softmax 概率 $p_k$。每个柱上方的数字是概率值。
Bars show softmax probabilities $p_k$ at.src: Bars show softmax probabilities $p_k$ at $T = 1$. Numbers above each bar are the probability values.

@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@\n Set all fiv.zh:
@@T0@@动手试试。@@T1@@
      将五个 logit 都设为相同的值（例如对所有 $k$ 令 $z_k = 0$）。会发生什么？你得到一个均匀分布 —— 当分数相等时 softmax 没有偏好。现在把 $z_1$ 设得很大（比如 $10$）。概率质量会坍缩到类别 1 上。这就是该函数得名的「软 argmax」行为。
@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@\n Set all fiv.src: Try this. Set all five logits to the same value (e.g. $z_k = 0$ for all $k$). What happens? You get a uniform distribution—softmax has no preference when scores are tied. Now make $z_1$ huge (say $10$). The probability mass collapses onto class 1. That's the "soft argmax" behavior the function is named for.

Now we add a knob. Divide every logit by.zh: 现在我们加入一个旋钮。在取 softmax 之前，将每个 logit 除以一个正数 $T$：
Now we add a knob. Divide every logit by.src:
Now we add a knob. Divide every logit by a positive number $T$ before
      taking softmax:

@@T0@@$T \\to 0$:@@T1@@ the largest logi.zh: @@T0@@$T \to 0$：@@T1@@ 最大的 logit 占主导。分布变为独热（argmax）。
@@T0@@$T \\to 0$:@@T1@@ the largest logi.src: $T \to 0$: the largest logit dominates. Distribution becomes one-hot (argmax).

@@T0@@$T \\to \\infty$:@@T1@@ all logits.zh: @@T0@@$T \to \infty$：@@T1@@ 所有 logit 都变为 $\approx 0$。分布变为均匀分布。
@@T0@@$T \\to \\infty$:@@T1@@ all logits.src: $T \to \infty$: all logits become $\approx 0$. Distribution becomes uniform.

So $T$ smoothly interpolates between &ld.zh: 因此 $T$ 在「总是挑选最好的」与「均匀随机地挑选」之间平滑地插值。滑动下面的温度，实时观察分布的变化。
So $T$ smoothly interpolates between &ld.src:
So $T$ smoothly interpolates between “always pick the best” and
      “pick uniformly at random”. Slide the temperature below and watch
      the distribution shift in real time.

Same logits as Step 1, now scaled by $1/.zh: 与第 1 步相同的 logit，现在按 $1/T$ 缩放。拖动滑块，观察分布如何从尖锐变为均匀。
Same logits as Step 1, now scaled by $1/.src: Same logits as Step 1, now scaled by $1/T$. Drag the slider to see the distribution morph from peaky to uniform.

@@T0@@Connection to entropy.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@与熵的联系。@@T1@@
      随着 $T$ 增大，分布变得平坦，其熵 $H$ 上升趋向 $\log K$（均匀分布的熵）。当 $T \to 0$ 时，$H \to 0$。温度实际上就是输出分布之熵上的一个旋钮。
@@T0@@Connection to entropy.@@T1@@\n.src: Connection to entropy. As $T$ grows, the distribution flattens and its entropy $H$ rises toward $\log K$ (the entropy of uniform). As $T \to 0$, $H \to 0$. Temperature is literally a knob on the entropy of the output distribution.

Sampling: turning probabilities into pic.zh: 采样：把概率转化为抽取

A probability distribution is just a rec.zh: 一个概率分布不过是一份产生随机性的配方。要从 softmax 中 @@T0@@采样@@T1@@，你抽取一个均匀随机数 $u \in [0,1]$，然后沿累积概率前进，直到超过 $u$。
A probability distribution is just a rec.src: A probability distribution is just a recipe for randomness. To sample from softmax, you draw a uniform random number $u \in [0,1]$ and walk along the cumulative probabilities until you exceed $u$.

Click @@T0@@Draw one sample@@T1@@ below..zh: 点击下面的 @@T0@@抽取一个样本@@T1@@。一条橙色竖线在位置 $u$ 处落到累积条上，它落入的类别即为抽中结果。试几次。现在把温度调高 —— 你会看到每个类别有时都会被抽中。把它调低 —— 总是同一个类别。
Click @@T0@@Draw one sample@@T1@@ below..src: Click Draw one sample below. A vertical orange line drops onto the cumulative bar at position $u$, and the class it lands in is the pick. Try it a few times. Now slide the temperature high—you'll see every class sometimes get picked. Slide it low—always the same class.

Top bar: cumulative probabilities by cla.zh: 顶部横条：各类别的累积概率（每个彩色分段的宽度为 $p_k$）。橙色标记：随机数 $u$ 的值。下方：最近若干次抽取的计数。
Top bar: cumulative probabilities by cla.src: Top bar: cumulative probabilities by class (each colored segment has width $p_k$). Orange marker: the random $u$ value. Beneath: a tally of recent draws.

@@T0@@Why this matters.@@T1@@\n Whe.zh:
@@T0@@为何这很重要。@@T1@@
      当一个 LLM「写出下一个词」时，发生的正是这件事：模型输出词表上的 logit，softmax 将其转化为概率，然后采样出下一个词元。低 $T$ → 稳妥、重复的文本。高 $T$ → 有创意但有时不连贯。你刚刚操控的正是 ChatGPT 作为「temperature」暴露出来的那个旋钮。
@@T0@@Why this matters.@@T1@@\n Whe.src: Why this matters. When an LLM “writes the next word”, this is exactly what's happening: the model outputs logits over the vocabulary, softmax converts them to probabilities, and the next token is sampled. Low $T$ → safe, repetitive text. High $T$ → creative but sometimes incoherent. You have just controlled the dial that ChatGPT exposes as “temperature”.

Sampling at scale: the law of large numb.src: Sampling at scale: the law of large numbers

One sample is random. A thousand samples.zh: 单个样本是随机的。一千个样本应当看起来像其背后的分布。点击 @@T0@@抽取 1000 个@@T1@@，观察经验直方图（实心）收敛到真实的 softmax 概率（轮廓）。
One sample is random. A thousand samples.src: One sample is random. A thousand samples should look like the underlying distribution. Click Draw 1000 and watch the empirical histogram (filled) converge onto the true softmax probabilities (outline).

This is the cleanest sanity check that s.zh: 这是最简洁的合理性检验，说明 softmax 确实计算出了一个合法的概率分布 —— 长期频率相符。
This is the cleanest sanity check that s.src:
This is the cleanest sanity check that softmax actually computes a valid
      probability distribution—the long-run frequencies match.

Filled bars: empirical frequencies from.zh: 实心柱：来自你样本的经验频率。轮廓柱：精确的 softmax 概率。随着 $N$ 增大，二者收敛。
Filled bars: empirical frequencies from.src: Filled bars: empirical frequencies from your samples. Outlined bars: the exact softmax probabilities. As $N$ grows, they converge.

@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@\n Draw 100 sa.zh:
@@T0@@动手试试。@@T1@@
      先抽取 100 个样本，再抽 1,000 个，然后抽 10,000 个（使用滑块）。实心柱每次都应更贴近轮廓。误差以 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 的速率缩小 —— 经典的蒙特卡洛收敛。
@@T0@@Try this.@@T1@@\n Draw 100 sa.src: Try this. Draw 100 samples, then 1,000, then 10,000 (use the slider). The filled bars should snap closer to the outlines each time. The error shrinks like $1/\sqrt{N}$—classic Monte Carlo convergence.

Where temperature shows up in practice.zh: 温度在实践中的出现场合
Where temperature shows up in practice.src: Where temperature shows up in practice

Controls creativity vs. coherence of gen.zh: 控制生成词元的创造力与连贯性之间的权衡
Controls creativity vs. coherence of gen.src: Controls creativity vs. coherence of generated tokens

Higher $T$ exposes the &ldquo;dark knowl.zh: 较高的 $T$ 揭示教师模型软 logit 中的「暗知识」
Higher $T$ exposes the &ldquo;dark knowl.src: Higher $T$ exposes the “dark knowledge” in the teacher's soft logits

Diffusion classifier-free guidance.zh: 扩散模型的无分类器引导

Plays a similar role: trades fidelity fo.zh: 扮演类似的角色：以保真度换取多样性
Plays a similar role: trades fidelity fo.src: Plays a similar role: trades fidelity for diversity

Reinforcement learning (Boltzmann explor.zh: 强化学习（玻尔兹曼探索）

Selects actions: high $T$ explores, low.zh: 选择动作：高 $T$ 探索，低 $T$ 利用
Selects actions: high $T$ explores, low.src: Selects actions: high $T$ explores, low $T$ exploits

A single learned $T$ rescales overconfid.zh: 单个学得的 $T$ 对过度自信的模型输出进行重新缩放
A single learned $T$ rescales overconfid.src: A single learned $T$ rescales overconfident model outputs

The same one-line formula&mdash;divide l.zh: 同一条一行的公式 —— 在 softmax 之前将 logit 除以 $T$ —— 贯穿于上述所有场景。一旦你理解了上面的柱状图，你就理解了它们全部。
The same one-line formula&mdash;divide l.src:
The same one-line formula—divide logits by $T$ before
      softmax—runs through all of these. Once you understand the bar chart
      above, you understand all of them.

Three things people get wrong about soft.zh: 人们对 softmax 常犯的三个错误
Three things people get wrong about soft.src: Three things people get wrong about softmax

@@T0@@&ldquo;Softmax outputs are calibra.zh:
@@T0@@「softmax 的输出就是校准良好的概率。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
          它们之和为 1，所以看起来像概率。但现代深度网络通常 @@T3@@过度自信@@T4@@ —— 最大的 softmax 值远高于模型在这些样本上的真实准确率。校准（如学得的温度缩放）可以修正这一点。
@@T0@@&ldquo;Softmax outputs are calibra.src:
“Softmax outputs are calibrated probabilities.”
They sum to one, so they look like probabilities. But modern deep networks are typically overconfident—the largest softmax value is much higher than the model's true accuracy on those examples. Calibration (like learned temperature scaling) fixes this.

@@T0@@&ldquo;You should apply softmax th.zh:
@@T0@@「你应该先应用 softmax，再用交叉熵损失。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
          并非如此。PyTorch 的 @@T3@@CrossEntropyLoss@@T4@@ 会在内部施加 softmax，计算两次会得到错误的梯度。请直接传入原始 logit。
@@T0@@&ldquo;You should apply softmax th.src:
“You should apply softmax then cross-entropy loss.”
You should not. PyTorch's CrossEntropyLoss applies softmax internally, and computing it twice gives wrong gradients. Pass raw logits.

@@T0@@&ldquo;Lower temperature is always.zh:
@@T0@@「温度越低总是越准确。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
          对于贪心解码（$T=0$），确实如此 —— 但若要在整个分布上评估，校准良好的概率（$T \approx 1$）能给出更好的不确定性估计，以及更好的下游流水线行为。
@@T0@@&ldquo;Lower temperature is always.src:
“Lower temperature is always more accurate.”
For greedy decoding ($T=0$), yes—but for evaluation across a distribution, calibrated probabilities ($T \approx 1$) give better uncertainty estimates and better downstream pipeline behavior.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n Softm.zh:
@@T0@@最终总结。@@T1@@
      softmax 是将无界分数转化为概率分布的典范方式。温度参数 $T$ 通过重塑该分布的熵，在确定性于多样性之间平滑权衡。你现在知道了每个 LLM API 里的那个滑块究竟在做什么。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n Softm.src: Final takeaway. Softmax is the canonical way to turn unbounded scores into a probability distribution. The temperature parameter $T$ smoothly trades determinism for diversity by reshaping the entropy of that distribution. You now know what the slider in every LLM API is actually doing.

Numerical stability — the &minus;max tri.zh: 数值稳定性 —— 减去最大值的技巧

The naive softmax $e^{z_i} / \\sum e^{z_.zh: 朴素的 softmax $e^{z_i} / \sum e^{z_j}$ 在 $z_i \gtrsim 700$（float64）和 $\gtrsim 88$（float32）时会溢出。每一个生产级实现都会在取指数之前减去最大的 logit：
The naive softmax $e^{z_i} / \\sum e^{z_.src: The naive softmax $e^{z_i} / \sum e^{z_j}$ overflows for $z_i \gtrsim 700$ (float64) and $\gtrsim 88$ (float32). Every production implementation subtracts the max logit before exponentiating:

softmax(z)@@T0@@i@@T1@@ = exp(z@@T2@@i@@.src: softmax(z)<sub>i</sub> = exp(z<sub>i</sub> − max(z)) / Σ<sub>j</sub> exp(z<sub>j</sub> − max(z))

The mathematical result is identical (th.zh: 数学结果完全相同（常数被抵消），但现在最大的指数恰好为 0，因此总和介于 1 与 $n$ 之间，永不溢出。在 torch.softmax / numpy.softmax 内部已经为你做好了这件事；如果你要从头编写 softmax（例如一个自定义 CUDA 核），这是你需要做的第一件事。
The mathematical result is identical (th.src: The mathematical result is identical (the constant cancels), but the largest exponent is now exactly 0, so the sum is between 1 and $n$ and never overflows. Inside torch.softmax / numpy.softmax this is done for you; if you're writing softmax from scratch (e.g. a custom CUDA kernel), this is the first thing you need.

The same trick gives @@T0@@logsumexp(z).zh: 同样的技巧给出 @@T0@@logsumexp(z) = max(z) + log Σ exp(z − max(z))@@T1@@，它是稳定的交叉熵与对数概率计算的基本构件。
The same trick gives @@T0@@logsumexp(z).src: The same trick gives logsumexp(z) = max(z) + log Σ exp(z − max(z)), the building block of stable cross-entropy and log-probability computations.

@@T0@@Sparsemax@@T1@@ (Martins &amp; Ast.zh: @@T0@@Sparsemax@@T1@@（Martins & Astudillo，2016）。将 logit 投影到单纯形上 —— 产生一个含若干精确零值的稀疏概率向量。在你需要硬性且可解释的选择的注意力头中很有用。
@@T0@@Sparsemax@@T1@@ (Martins &amp; Ast.src: Sparsemax (Martins & Astudillo, 2016). Projects logits onto the simplex — produces a sparse probability vector with some exact zeros. Useful in attention heads where you want hard, interpretable choices.

@@T0@@Entmax-α@@T1@@ (Peters et&nbsp;al..zh: @@T0@@Entmax-α@@T1@@（Peters 等，2019）。在 softmax（$\alpha = 1$）与 sparsemax（$\alpha = 2$）之间插值。是一个单参数族。
@@T0@@Entmax-α@@T1@@ (Peters et&nbsp;al..src: Entmax-α (Peters et al., 2019). Interpolates softmax ($\alpha = 1$) and sparsemax ($\alpha = 2$). One-parameter family.

@@T0@@Gumbel-softmax@@T1@@ (Jang et&nbsp.zh: @@T0@@Gumbel-softmax@@T1@@（Jang 等，2017；Maddison 等，2017）。向 logit 加入 Gumbel 噪声，再以低温度做 softmax —— 产生近似独热的、且 @@T2@@可微@@T3@@ 的样本。是离散隐变量的标准重参数化技巧。
@@T0@@Gumbel-softmax@@T1@@ (Jang et&nbsp.src: Gumbel-softmax (Jang et al., 2017; Maddison et al., 2017). Add Gumbel noise to logits, then softmax with low temperature — produces near-one-hot samples that are differentiable. The standard reparameterisation trick for discrete latent variables.

@@T0@@Top-k / nucleus (top-p) sampling.@.zh: @@T0@@Top-k / 核采样（top-p）。@@T1@@ 在采样前将 softmax 的支撑集限制在前 $k$ 个词元（或和为 $p$ 的最小集合）。是现代 LLM 文本生成中的标准做法。
@@T0@@Top-k / nucleus (top-p) sampling.@.src: Top-k / nucleus (top-p) sampling. Restrict softmax support to the top-$k$ tokens (or smallest set summing to $p$) before sampling. Standard in modern LLM text generation.

Bridle (1990) — first usage of \"softmax.zh: Bridle（1990）—— 首次将「softmax」用于神经网络输出归一化。
Bridle (1990) — first usage of \"softmax.src: Bridle (1990) — first usage of "softmax" for neural-net output normalisation.

Hinton, Vinyals, Dean (2015) — Knowledge.src: Hinton, Vinyals, Dean (2015) — Knowledge Distillation, popularised the temperature parameter.

Holtzman et&nbsp;al. (2020) — @@T0@@The.zh: Holtzman 等（2020）—— @@T0@@The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration。@@T1@@ 核采样。
Holtzman et&nbsp;al. (2020) — @@T0@@The.src: Holtzman et al. (2020) — The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration. Nucleus sampling.

meta.title: Softmax 与温度
meta.tagline: 温度如何重塑一个概率分布 —— 以及如何从中采样
meta.summary: 实时编辑 logit，观察 softmax 如何将它们转化为概率。将温度旋钮从 0.05 滑到 5，看一个尖锐的分布如何变为均匀分布。一次抽取一个样本，或一次抽取 10,000 个 —— 这正是驱动 ChatGPT 创造力、知识蒸馏与校准的那个旋钮。
highlights: 从可编辑的 logit 入手，观察 softmax 在放大差异的同时如何保持次序。
拖动温度滑块，观察分布如何从 argmax 变为均匀，并配有实时的熵读数。
逐个抽取样本，看随机数 u 落在累积条上的位置 —— 这正是 LLM 挑选下一个词元的机制。
运行 10,000 个样本，观察经验直方图收敛到真实的 softmax 概率（实时的蒙特卡洛收敛）。
温度在现实中出现的五个场景：LLM 生成、蒸馏、扩散引导、强化学习探索与校准。
